__broaden__.ne: -(n)e — dative-locative: at, in, to (front-vowel form) [行] · also on names, De-Sečen-(n)e and Höġelün-(n)e, 'to De-Sechen, to Högelün' (Ming 行), where the (n) is Shiratori's · also -(n)e after küġün (küġün-(n)e), the agent after a passive, 'by a person' (Ming 被人行) · also müren-(n)e, 'to the river' (müren ends in n; the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 河 行)
__broaden__.na: -(n)a — dative-locative: at, in, to (back-vowel form) [行] · also a particle na (Ming 好生 'well, very'; sense uncertain), in bolγaqu na žöb, 'to be made, na, right' (§126) · also Waṅ-Qān-(n)a, 'to Wang Qan' (after a stem ending in n; the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 人名行)
__broaden__.qān: qān — ruler, sovereign, khan (title, the short form beside qaγan; here after a name) [皇帝] · also Qān- cut at the line end before luγ̇a, 'with the Qan'; the hyphen is the printer's
__broaden__.dužu: -dužu — the second half of the reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu, split from keġel- across a line break; together keġeldužu, 'saying to one another' (extension + converb) [着] · also split from saγ̇al- (the stem saγa- + -l-), together saγ̇al-dužu, 'milking together'
__broaden__.aduγ̇un: aduγ̇un — herd of horses (noun) [馬羣] · also 'livestock, beasts' (Ming 頭口), olžalaγsad aduγ̇un 'the livestock of those who had taken spoil'
